_doc: Seat definitions for the ICP panel. Each seat is a fixed slice of data/corpus.json. Seats are NOT characters; they are scoped query surfaces. Never add a backstory, name, mood, or biography to a seat. Setup replaces {{COMPANY}} with your company name; the filters work as shipped.

excluded_sources.your own messaging: Any positioning doc, message house, website copy or sales script you wrote. Grounding a verdict in it grades your copy against your copy. Never load it into an evidence pack. Setup records the file names in references/profile.json under excluded_docs.
excluded_sources.draft under review: The copy being judged is never added to the evidence base.

density_bands._note: n >= 12 allows a full verdict. 5-11 allows a verdict that MUST be labeled weak signal. n < 5 forbids a verdict; return no-evidence.

_widening_note: Retrieve at the narrowest requested filter first. If below the sufficient band, drop one dimension at a time in this order and re-retrieve. Never widen past the seat's base_filter; that is the seat's identity. Always report the precision level actually used.

cold_skeptic.role: Judges whether a piece of content lands on someone who has never heard of {{COMPANY}}.
cold_skeptic._interview_note: Interviews (podcast guests, research calls) are ICP people who are not in a buying conversation, which is exactly this seat's job. Their problem language is legitimate here. It is NOT legitimate in the objector or decider seats.
may_answer: Is this the problem they actually have
Is this framing foreign to them
What unresolved questions does this reader carry

objector.role: Surfaces what makes a reader stop, bounce, or not reply.
may_answer: What in this makes them stop reading
What objection does this raise and not answer

decider.role: Judges close-stage copy: proposals, late sequence emails, the offer or pricing page.
decider._source_note: Restricted to buying-context calls. An existing client's late-stage objection is about the next phase of work, not about deciding to buy.
may_answer: Does this resolve the last objection
What has to be true before they move
may_not_answer: Whether a cold reader understands the category

client.role: Post-sale reality only. Retention, expansion, what working with {{COMPANY}} feels like.
client._scope_warning: These people have already absorbed your framing and mostly discuss the work itself. This seat is near-worthless for judging acquisition copy and must never be used for it.
may_answer: Would an existing client find this useful
Does this match what working with us actually feels like
